Karnataka faces water scarcity, allocates funds for rural supply

Karnataka is experiencing a significant rainfall deficit, leading to low dam levels and concerns about water availability. The state government has allocated Rs 117 crore for rural water supply and advised farmers to postpone sowing. This situation highlights the challenges posed by the monsoon deficit on agriculture and rural communities.
